clarification_reconciliation: ADR-0026 D46 CR02 separates the clarification source identity/revision (input.clarification.revision) from the primary target revision (input.clarification.expected_revision, which equals input.source.revision). The legacy ClarificationEvidence constructor is preserved unchanged until its planned C009/C023 migration; the schema binding and this mapping are the C004 obligation.
money_reconciliation: ADR-0027 D47 BP01: the v2 snapshot.price copy binds the existing scaled money representation as canonical nonnegative integer amount/scale 0..9/nonblank currency/closed basis. Wire state=unknown with null amount/scale/currency maps mechanically to the existing explicit unknown Price alternative (whose internal placeholders are 0/0/empty); state governs unknown and no numeric zero or free price is inferred. schemas/hyf_v1_jev/money.schema.json and the domain constructors are unchanged and are not reused as the strict v2 validator.
provenance_reconciliation: ADR-0027 D47 BP01: output.provenance is required on every successful v2 result and carries only the immutable identities actually used. It is independent of optional detailed evidence and of context.return_provenance; the flag continues to govern optional detailed evidence only. Identity equality, actual use, uniqueness and coverage/allocation agreement are semantic obligations owned by C009/C023/C030/C038/C041; C004 binds the closed wire shapes and executes the paired controls.
unavailability: C004 parses the corrected context and then refuses dispatch with capability_unavailable until C042-C046 activate the operations.
